derived_from.note: One astronaut on the same route: every number is copied unchanged from the engine route file, because the engine's O2 model is per crew member with no crew-size term (engine/export.py) and its turn-back uses the largest member factor, 1.0 for everyone (engine/route/pnr.py). Walking alone is a Scenario; NASA plans EVAs in pairs (NASA-SP-2009-566).

back_fast.method: Shortest modeled time from each route point to the habitat pixel on the same native graph and corridor (Dijkstra on reversed edges); t_s and o2_l are raw expected values per crew member with no reserve or margin, like back. path is stored only at the route points in path_from (first, last, one every 25 m of route); the way home from another point is the route walked back to the nearest earlier key point, then that path. path is simplified for display (1 m Ramer-Douglas-Peucker, one native pixel); costs use the unsimplified pixel path.
